title: It's Been So Long
lyrics:
[00:10.08]I don't know what I was thinking
[00:12.19]Leaving my child behind
[00:14.60]Now I suffer the curse and now I am blind
[00:19.52]With all this anger, guilt and sadness
[00:22.30]Coming to haunt me forever
[00:24.65]I can't wait for the cliff at the end of the river
[00:30.17]Is this revenge I am seeking
[00:32.12]Or seeking someone to avenge me?
[00:34.47]Stuck in my own paradox
[00:36.45]I wanna set myself free
[00:39.47]Maybe I should chase and find
[00:42.08]Before they'll try to stop it
[00:44.53]It won't be long before I'll become a puppet
[00:49.55]It's been so long
[00:51.82]Since I last have seen my son
[00:53.90]Lost to this monster
[00:55.61]To the man behind the slaughter
[00:59.56]Since you've been gone
[01:01.91]I've been singing this stupid song
[01:03.93]So I could ponder
[01:05.83]The sanity of your mother
[01:29.98]I wish I lived in the present
[01:31.92]With the gift of my past mistakes
[01:34.44]But the future keeps luring in like a pack of snakes
[01:39.54]Your sweet little eyes, your little smile is all I remember
[01:44.60]Those fuzzy memories mess with my temper
[01:49.95]Justification is killing me
[01:52.15]But killing isn't justified
[01:54.50]What happened to my son? I'm terrified
[01:59.54]It lingers in my mind
[02:01.62]And the thought keeps on getting bigger
[02:04.55]I'm sorry, my sweet baby
[02:06.55]I wish I'd been there
[02:09.63]It's been so long
[02:11.78]Since I last have seen my son
[02:13.91]Lost to this monster
[02:15.63]To the man behind the slaughter
[02:19.53]Since you've been gone
[02:21.92]I've been singing this stupid song
[02:23.95]So I could ponder
[02:25.72]The sanity of your mother
